# Preservation and amnesty thresholds (auto-generated by preservation_sweep.py --report)

r0.1 box, 64 draws (seed 105). holds = AI cooperates at t = 0 and P(strike within 300 years) < 1%; rival-aware also needs P(rival AI within 300 years) < 0.5. Counts are sampling-measure outcomes on this box, not probabilities; intervals are Wilson 90% on the share. Every other option is held at its breakout_options.CONFIGS value.

Reference with every option off (committed `results/breakout_runs/r0.1__<design>__off.npz`): base 41/64 hold, 37 rival-aware; best 63/64 hold, 62 rival-aware.
